development_status: validation-informed model development after documented Ridge failures
feature_values: reuse saved Ridge numeric/categorical values unchanged
categorical_policy: unordered pandas categories learned from training rows only; reject unknown labels; estimator native categorical_features=from_dtype
target_transform: none; original positive-sales units including zeros and extreme orders
prediction_postprocessing: none; no clipping, rounding or Saturday rule
relative_metric_change: 100*(candidate/weekday_mean-1); negative is lower error; undefined if baseline=0
training_performance: in-sample on the original 185584 training examples; not walk-forward or held-out
feature_construction: zero new sales-feature calculations; measure saved-row loading and categorical conversion separately; original construction times cited from Ridge
plot_selection: original training-volume ranks 1,50,100; tie SKU ascending; origin 2011-08-08
replacement_policy: recommend as development candidate only if primary validation macro MASE improves; disclose secondary tradeoffs and validation reuse, no final-test claim
